    static long[] fac;
    static long[] invfac;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = scanner.nextInt();
        long lmao = scanner.nextLong();

        } else {

                    result = (result - temp + MOD) % MOD;
                else
                    result = (result + temp) % MOD;
            }
            result = (result * nCr(C, N)) % MOD;
            if (K > 0)
                result = (2 * result) % MOD;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
        scanner.close();
    }

    static void initializeFactorials() {
        fac = new long[200001];
        invfac = new long[200001];
        fac[0] = 1L;
        invfac[0] = 1L;

            fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
            invfac[i] = power(fac[i], MOD - 2, MOD);
        }
    }

    public static long nCr(int a, int b) {
        long res = fac[b];
        res = (res * invfac[a]) % MOD;
        res = (res * invfac[b - a]) % MOD;
        return res;
    }

    public static long power(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1L;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1)
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
        }
        return result;
    }
